test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is wild.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• *Wild- living or growing in the natural environment; **not domesticated or cultivated**.*
 
• Tame- Not dangerous or frightened of people; **domesticated**.
 
• Dangerous- **Able or likely to cause harm** or injury.
 
• Elegant- **Graceful** and stylish in appearance or manner.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is 'wild'.
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

 

The correct sentence is: Other threats to **w**____**ild**__ elephants include habitat destruction and conflicts with local people.
